notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
